sales_pivot.title: Sales pivot: category by year
sales_pivot.description: Revenue and quantity per sales category and year, with branch and salesman filters. Real Excel PivotTable (drag fields to re-arrange).
sales_pivot.sql: SELECT mname AS category, branchcode AS branch, salesmna AS salesman, customername AS customer, brandname AS brand, cyyyy AS year, cmn AS month, salesamt AS revenue, totqty AS quantity FROM sales.invoices

ledger_pivot.title: Ledger pivot: account by year
ledger_pivot.description: Debit and credit per ledger account and year (e.g. VAT, sales accounts). Real Excel PivotTable.
ledger_pivot.sql: SELECT accountname AS account, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM vchdt)::int AS year, dramount AS debit, cramount AS credit FROM sales.account_entries
